## Change a translation

If anything is unclear, ask in [Discord](https://wowlab.gg/go/discord). Native speakers make these translations better, so please ask rather than getting stuck on the tooling.

Use English as the source. Edit the matching `<domain>.content.ts` file in every locale directory. Translate values only. Keep dictionary names, keys, and placeholders unchanged. Keep every translation entry on one line, regardless of length.

Each file uses the factory for its directory:

```ts
import { en } from "../i18n";

// prettier-ignore
export default en("sharedGame", {
  "difficultyHeroic": "Heroic",
  "difficultyMythic": "Mythic",
});
```

## Content patterns

Static text is a string:

```ts
"welcomeBack": "Welcome back.",
```

Use `insert` for placeholders:

```ts
"activityReading": insert("Reading {{table}}"),
```

```tsx
content.activityReading({ table });
```

Use `plural` for counts. Intlayer selects the CLDR plural category for the active locale and inserts the count:

```ts
"matchingEncounters": plural({ one: "{{count}} matching encounter.", other: "{{count}} matching encounters." }),
```

```tsx
content.matchingEncounters(count);
```

Run `pnpm check:i18n` from the repository root before opening a pull request.

## Add a locale

1. Add it to `packages/shared/src/lib/seo/locales.ts`.
2. Export its factory from `packages/shared/src/i18n/i18n.ts`.
3. Copy `packages/shared/src/i18n/en/` and switch each file to the new factory.
4. Translate the values and run `pnpm check:i18n`.
